relationships.subject: A-803467
relationships.evidence_quote: A-803467, which binds to Site CC4, is a Nav1.8-selective blocker66

key_findings: Cryo-EM structures of human Nav1.7 with bupivacaine, lacosamide, carbamazepine, vinpocetine, hardwickiic acid, vixotrigine and PF-05089771 at 2.6-3.2 A reveal a new site BIG beneath the intracellular gate and fenestration sites.
A letter-coded nomenclature is proposed for druggable sites on Nav channels.
